ORIGINAL ISSUE: Unable to add API key for Kilo provider
The release notes for `v0.13.0` state:

> Optional keys for AI Horde, Kilo and OVH. These providers work without a key, and now you can also save a real key for them to get your own account's limits. Custom providers without a key no longer send a placeholder Authorization header. (#1356, #1332, closes #1331).

while the following PR appears to provide the option to edit & add a key in the dashboard:
- [#1356](https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi/pull/1356) which notes:
> Add key form: for key-optional providers the field is editable with an "Optional" placeholder, a hint explaining both modes, and the Get API key link as before. Blank submits "Enable"; a pasted key submits "Add key".
> Edit dialog: the anonymous row can take a real key.

However, following an update to `v0.13.0` attempting to edit the existing entry for `Kilo Gateway (no key needed)` and add an existing API KEY fails, as the `API key` field has uneditable placeholder text "No API key needed", providing no way to add the API key. 
Additionally attempting to add a new key only exposes the single entry for `Kilo`: `Kilo Gateway (no key needed)`, so there is not an alternate option available that would allow for adding an API key.
